description.decoded:
We just received word from the residents of Ashford that Farmer Hamnet has gone missing. He was last seen heading up to Wizard's Folly to gather supplies, but was due back hours ago. His neighbors are starting to get nervous, so we have agreed to send a search party. Are you interested in leading the search? This seems like the perfect way for you to get some more experience under your belt!

Reward:<brx>1,000 Experience<brx>50 Gold<brx>
